brand.name: Basecamp
brand.summary: Basecamp offers a straightforward, all-in-one project management platform that unifies tasks, discussions, files, and schedules. It emphasizes simplicity, reliability, and a calm user experience for teams of any size, with apps for iOS, Android, Mac, Windows, web, and command line.
